description_en: Queries the tags that are added to cloud resources which are Resource Access Management (RAM) roles and policies
description_zh: 查询云资源（RAM角色、权限策略）绑定的标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun ram list-tag-resources --resource-type role --resource-names role1 --tag Value=v1 Key=t1 --page-size 100 --next-token GY/oWREsOP1bPHGcHGrXfYX7UG1k9KqWFYThNDPx1UX26PbWOIu2CMqqiMr68H/K --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

Enumerated values:

- role: RAM roles.

- policy: policies
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The names of the resources. You can specify up to 50 resource names
parameters.help_zh: 资源名称列表，一次最多支持输入50个资源名称
parameters.name: resource_names

element_fields.help_en: The key of the tag. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length
element_fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The value of the tag. The tag value can be up to 256 characters in length
element_fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一次最多支持输入20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.name: next_token
